title: Tadap ke kehte hai
body:
arsa e hashr mein jis waqt ke aayengi batool
kehke farzando ka gham sab ko rulayengi batool
lab pe mazkoor shahadat ka hilayengi batool
arsh ke paaye ko ro ro ke hilayengi batool
us ghadi sharm se moo phayr na lena zaalim
khoon baha fatema zehra ko to dena zaalim
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap ke kehte hai sajjad ay phuphi amma
yazeed kehta hai baba ka khoon baha lelo
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mera baba jise fatema ne paala tha
nabi ka noor e nazar deen ka ujaala tha
na uski laash ko koi uthaane waala tha
main uth na sakta tha aur samne padi thi laash
sina ki nok pe sar tha tadap rahi thi laash
tadap ke kehte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chacha ke sadme ne baba ki tod'di thi kamar
jawan ki laash par pahunche thay ghutniyo chal kar
utha ke laaye thay kaandhe pe laasha e akbar
kaha ye bano se jaan se guzar gaye akbar
nikaali hum ne jo barchi to mar gaye akbar
tadap ke kehte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek aankh lahoo se bhigo gaye qasim
chale jo ghode to taapo mein kho gaye qasim
ke zindagi mein hi pamaal ho gaye qasim
ragadte aediyan qasim ka kya sila dega
har ek laash ke tukde ke badle kya dega
tadap ke kehte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha jalaal mein zainab ne uski ye jurrat
kaho ye us se ke kya dega woh hamein daulat
tum us se poocho ke abbas ki hai kya keemat
ye jo lahoo bhare gaysu hai inka kya dega
ye jo kate huwe baazu hai inka kya dega
tadap ke kehte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi bataye usay kya hai ambiya ka hussain
pisar rasool ka aur kya hai murtuza ka hussain
wo teen roz ka pyasa wo fatema ka hussain
nahi pata dil e zehra ke chain ki keemat
khuda se pooch le kya hai hussain ki keemat
tadap ke kehte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
juda badan se tha sar aur tha kaleja paash
padi thi ghodon se pamaal tez dhoop mein laash
yahan talaash rida ki wahan kafan ki talaash
chupa loo badle ke armaan ko mai phuphi amma
bhula doo shaam e ghariban ko mai phuphi amma
tadap ke kehte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajab hai haal sakina ka maa ko sakta hai
rasan galay mein hai seene mein dam atakta hai
larazte ashk hai kaano se khoon tapakta hai
gohar jo kaano se cheene thy inka kya dega
tamache isne jo khaaye hai inka kya dega
tadap ke kehte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
phirayi jaati thi galiyon mein itrat e athaar
rida saron pe na thi aur majma e aghyaar
bhula doo kaise mai beta wo shaam ka bazaar
baataye karb e yateema ki kya jaza dega
sina ki nok se khaynchi rida ka kya dega
tadap ke kehte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qamar rubab ko maloom hai sagheer ki pyaas
hai cheh mahine ke bache ke zakhm ka ehsaas
chupaye rakhti hai jhoole ki lakdiyan ye paas
kaho yazeed se baysheer ki khata kya hai
ke cheh mahine ke bache ka khoon baha kya hai
tadap ke kehte hai...
author: Qamar Hasnain
